coverage_note: A bounded manual registry of known cash-acquisition events, not a live news feed, exhaustive corporate-action screen, or clearance of unlisted stocks. Each event records its own source dates and manual review date. Unresolved events stay excluded after review_due and require a new source review; expected closing dates and go-shop deadlines never automatically clear a stock.

events.reason: MISTRAS announced an agreement for H.I.G. affiliates to acquire its shares for $20.35 in cash. The announced go-shop runs through October 27, 2026. Deal pricing and a possible deal break are outside this momentum strategy; no new entry ticket.

sources.title: MISTRAS enters definitive agreement to be acquired by H.I.G. Capital
sources.quote: Under the terms of the agreement, MISTRAS stockholders will receive $20.35 per share in cash for each share of common stock they own.

events.reason: Priority announced a CEO-led take-private agreement for $8.05 per share in cash, expected at announcement to close in the first half of 2027. Deal pricing and a possible deal break are outside this momentum strategy; no new entry ticket.

sources.title: Priority enters definitive agreement with Chairman and CEO Thomas Priore to take company private
sources.quote: Holders of Priority's common stock (other than shares held by the Investor Group) will receive $8.05 per share in cash at the closing of the transaction.

events.reason: Accelerant announced an all-cash acquisition by Thoma Bravo at $20.25 per share. Deal pricing and a possible deal break are outside this momentum strategy; no new entry ticket.

sources.title: Accelerant enters definitive agreement to be acquired by Thoma Bravo
sources.quote: Under the terms of the agreement, Accelerant Class A and Class B stockholders will receive $20.25 per share in cash.

sources.title: Accelerant announces expiration of go-shop period
sources.quote: The transaction is still expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions, including approval by Accelerant shareholders and receipt of required regulatory approvals.

events.reason: Baldwin announced an acquisition by affiliates of Sequence Holdings and the Dell Family Office for $32.50 per share in cash, expected at announcement to close in the first quarter of 2027. Deal pricing and a possible deal break are outside this momentum strategy; no new entry ticket.

sources.title: Baldwin to be acquired by Sequence Holdings and Dell Family Office
sources.quote: Baldwin shareholders will receive $32.50 in cash for each share of Baldwin common stock they hold.

events.reason: ACV announced Copart's $10.50 per share cash tender offer and merger. Deal pricing and a possible deal break are outside this momentum strategy; no new entry ticket.

sources.title: ACV Auctions Form 8-K: merger agreement with Copart
sources.quote: $10.50 per share, net to the seller in cash, without interest, subject to any required withholding of taxes

sources.title: ACV Auctions Schedule 14D-9 amendment: tender extension
sources.quote: has been further extended until 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on October 15, 2026
